svg.title: AL JAMAL Pure Desi Ghee — jar label 1 kg (254 × 95 mm + 3 mm bleed)

text.tspan: Fresh milk is cultured into dahi, churned into
makkhan and slow-cooked over a low flame until
golden and fragrant. Nothing added, nothing
taken away — only the taste of home.
Keep sealed in a cool, dry place away from sunlight.
Always use a clean, dry spoon. No refrigeration needed.
